capability.summary: Fetch one random Dog CEO image URL for an optional breed
capability.description: Calls Dog CEO's random-image endpoint: with a breed it uses the breed path, and without one it uses the all-breeds random endpoint. The wrapper returns the API's JSON message/status object; it does not download or emit image bytes.
capability.problem_space: Random dog image URL retrieval by optional breed; not image downloading, breed classification, veterinary information, or image generation.

constraint.io_signature: Input: optional breed at CLI position 1. Output: shared JSON envelope containing Dog CEO JSON result, URL, and HTTP status. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
accepted_inputs: optional Dog CEO breed path such as hound or retriever/golden
constraint.output_shape: HTTP 2xx/3xx: {status: "success", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}. HTTP 4xx/5xx: {status: "error", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}, exit 1. Request exception: {status: "error", tool: string, message: string}, exit 1.
limitations: breed supplied: fixed GET https://dog.ceo/api/breed/<breed>/images/random; omitted breed: fixed GET https://dog.ceo/api/breeds/image/random
no image bytes, count, list, size, format, pagination, or batch input; all CLI arguments after position 1 are ignored
wrapper does not URL-encode, validate, download, parse, paginate, or truncate the provider JSON
random selection and provider availability are external and no auth/cache/retry is used
HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.

output_contract.description: Shared JSON envelope containing the Dog CEO random image URL/message, URL, and HTTP status.

intent_tags: get a random dog image URL
retrieve a Dog CEO image by breed
negative_intents: identify a dog breed from a photo

output_contract.description: Shared JSON envelope containing the Dog CEO random image URL/message, URL, and HTTP status.
